Not shown because they depend on your district or school system: Etowah County Commission Districts 1, 4, 5 and 6, and Etowah County Board of Education Districts 1, 2 and 3 (elected only by voters in the county school system, not Gadsden, Attalla or other city schools). No city race or question appears on this ballot. Incumbents are not marked because the ballot does not identify incumbents. Check your official sample ballot for district races.

measures.title: Etowah County: repeal of voter-approval requirement for certain annexations (Act 2026-276)
measures.summary: A local amendment to the Constitution of Alabama of 2022 that applies only to Etowah County. It would repeal Section 28-11.20, which requires voter approval before territory in the county can be annexed into a municipality that was not located wholly within the county before January 1, 1986.
measures.yesMeans: The voter-approval requirement for annexing Etowah County territory into such municipalities would be repealed.
measures.noMeans: The constitution is not amended and voter approval is still required for those annexations.
